entries.german:
Das Domcapitel und das Johanniterhaus zu Wirzburg beurkunden den Schiedspruch über ihre Zwistigkeiten vom 23. August. Wir Karl von Hesseburg
techant vnd daz gantz capitel ge-
meynlichen des styftes zû dem
tume zû Wirtzburg bekennen
offenlichen an disem brief fur vns
vnd alle vnser nachkumen, daz
wir vmb alle schulde bruche zû
sprûche vnd zweyunge dy wir
von vnsers styftes wegen biz her
haben gehabt mit vnd zû den er-
samen geistlichen luten dem co-
mentûr vnd dem conuent des huses
zû Wirtzburg sant Johans
ordens des heiligen spitals zû Jhe-
rusalem fruntlichen vnd gutlichen
mit vnserm g[u]ten willen verriht
vnd geeynt sin vff dy erbern lute
die wir vff beide siten dar zû be-
scheiden haben: vff vnsere vnd
vnsers capitels siten hern Ar-
nolden von Sparneck vnd
hern Nyclausz von Malkôzz,
tumherren in vnserm vorgenanten
styfte; her Friderich Zuren
custer, her Nyclaus Danyel
sangmeister in dem styfte zum
Nuwenmunster vff dy andern
siten; her Cunrat von Geu-
rychsheim techant in dem sel-
ben styft zum Nuwenmûnster,
der zû einem vngeraden vff beide
siten gegeben vnd genûmen ist.

Wir Cunrat von Bybern
balirer zû Francken vnd co-
mentur zû Wizzense, Johans
Mercklin comentûr, bruder
Cunrat Kyseling, Hans Me-
gelin, Heinrich Trûhsezz,
bruder Han, bruder Rychart,
vnd der conuente gemeinlichen
des hus zû Wirtzburg sant
Johans ordens des heiligen spi-
tals von Jherusalem bekennen
offenlich an disem brief fur vns
vnd fur alle vnsere nachkumen,
daz wir von aller schulde bruche
vnd zûspruche vnd zweyunge
wegen als vns vnd vnserm hus
dy erwirdigen herren der . . te-
chant vnd daz capitel des styfts
zûm tume zû Wirtzburg von
des selben irs styfts wegen haben
zû gesprochen vnd [an?] gereicht
biz her daz wir vmb dy selben
schulde brûche zûspruche vnd
zweyunge gutlich vnd fruntlichen
mit vnserm gutem willen sin ver-
ryht vnd geeynt mit in vff dy
erbern lute dy hernach geschriben
sten: her Arnolt von Sparn-
eck, her Nyclaus von Mal-
kôs, tumherren in dem obgenan-
ten styfte zû Wirtzburg, vf ire
siten; her Friderich Zûrn
custer, her Nyclaus Danyel
sangmeister im styfte zum Nuwen
munster vf vnser siten; her
Cunrat von Gewrychsheim
techant in dem selben styfte zûm
Nûwen munster, der da zû
einem vngeraden vf beide siten
gegeben ist.
Vnd dy selben funfe eynmûtlichen haben vns geryht vnd geeynt
in aller wyse als hernach von worten zû worten geschriben stet:
Wir Arnolt von Sparneck, Nyclaus von Mal-
kuzz, tumherren zû Wirtzburg, Cunrat von Geu-
richsheim techant des styfts zum Nuwenmûnster zû
Wirtzburg, Nyclaus Danyel vnd Friderich
Zuren, korherren in dem selben styft zum Nuwen-
mûnster, bekennen vnd tun kunt offenlichen an disem
brief allen den die in an sehen oder horen lesen: vmb
alle vorderunge clage vnd ansprach kryeg zweyunge vnd
gebresten als dy erbern herren der techant vnd daz ca-
pitel des styfts zum tume zû Wirtzburg vf ein siten,
vnd der comentûr vnd dy bruder gemeinlichen in dem
huse zû Wirtzburg sant Johans ordens des heiligen
spitals von Jherusalem vnd auch dy phleger des selben
hûs vff dy andern siten gen ein ander gehabt haben, von
zinse gût gulte vnd schulde wegen als dy vorgenanten
heuser herren dem techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten
styfts zum tume schuldig sin als hernach geschriben stet.
des hat der techant vnd daz capitel des vorgenanten styfts
zum tume vff ire siten dar zu geben vnd bescheiden vns
zwen Arnolden von Sparneck vnd Nyclausz von
Malkôzz obgenant; so haben dy vorgenanten heuser herren
des hus zû Wirtzburg vff ir siten dar zû geben vnd
bescheiden vns zwen Nyclaus Danyel vnd Friderich
Zûrn obgenant; vnd dy vorgenant beide party haben mich
Cunrat von Geurychsheim techant zum Nuwen-
munster, den obgenanten, zu einem obman geben vnd be-
scheiden in disen sachen: vnd dy vorgenant beide party
haben wir auch globt mit hant gegeben trûwen an eydes
stat, waz wir funfe oder der merteil zwyschen den vor-
genanten beiden partyen scheiden oder machen, daz sullen
sy vf beide siten stet vnd vest halten vff dy trûwe dy
sy dar vber geben haben vnd vff dy pene als hernach-
geschriben stet ôn geuerde.
Des ersten so haben wir funf obgenant eintmutlichen
gemacht vnd gescheiden, daz dy obgenanten herren von
sant Johans dem techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten
styfts schicken sullen von den von Rosenberg von
iren erben oder von iren nachkumen dy Boxperg jn
haben oder in gewinnen gut brief vnd vrkunde noch
haltunge vnd sage der noteln der bede party vber eyn
kumen sin vmb dy zehen phunt heller vnd vier malter
weizzes jerlicher gulte dy sy von alter her gehabt haben
vff dem huse vnd stat zû Boxperg mit sinen zû ge-
horenden. Daz sol geschehen vnd ein ende nemen vnuer-
zogenlichen hye zwischen vnd wyhenahten dy nû schierst
kumen ôn geuerde. Were aber daz dy herren von sant
Johans der vorgenanten brief vnd vrkunde niht geschicken
konden von den von Rosenberg in der wyse als vor-
geschriben stet, so sullen sy dem techant vnd dem styfte
zû Wirtzburg die obgeschriben jerlichen gulte bewysen
vnd verschriben vff dem hus zû sant Johans zû Wirtz-
burg vnd vff dem hoff zûm Hofschultheizzen gelegen
in der stat zû Wirtzburg mit iren zugehorenden also
daz sy der obgeschriben jerlichen gulte sicher vnd gewys
sin sullen als vff andern iren zinsguten so lange biz daz
Bybelriet daz hûs wider in des ordens hant kumet:
so sullen sy danne dy obgenant jerlichen gulte bewysen
vnd verschriben daz sy der furbaz dar vff habende sin
vnd warten sullen als vff andern iren zinsguten. Vnd
daz sol geschehen mit gunst willen vnd verhenckniss
vnsers herren von Wirtzburg. Vnd daz auch dem
techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten styfts daz volendet
vnd volbraht werde in der wyse als vorgeschriben stet,
dar nach sullen dy vorgenanten herren von sant Johans
vnd ir nachkumen getrulichen werben schicken vnd vol-
enden vf die truwe dy sy dar vber gegeben haben ôn
alles geuerde.
Dar nach so haben wir funf obgenant einmûtlichen
gemacht vnd gescheiden, daz dy vorgenanten herren von sant
Johans jerlichen reichen vnd geben sullen dem techant
vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten styfts vnd iren nachkumen
vierzig phunt wahs in aller wyse vnd mözze als sy in dy von alter her gegeben haben. Were aber daz dy ob-
genanten herren von sant Johans dy gut da von sy dy selben vierzig phunt wahs geben konden [?] vnd mohten
ledig vnd los gemachen in disen drûwen jaren von allen
erbschaften rehten zinsen vnd gulten, vnd in dy auch
lediclichen mohten geantwurten vnd vff geben fur ir
eygen gut vnd on alles hindernisse, so sullen sy dy selben
gut von den herren von sant Johans vfnemen: vnd
sullen sy danne der vierzig phunde wahs jerlicher gulte
ledig vnd los sagen on geuerde.
Auch haben wir obgenant funf einmutlichen gemacht
vnd gescheiden, daz dy vorgenanten herren von sant Jo-
hans sullen beleuhten vnd brunnen dy aht lampen lieht
in dem styft zum tume zu Wirtzburg, der sint siben
vff sant Kylians kore, vnd eins vor vnser frauwen altare.
Daz sullen sy tun als sy die von alter her gebrant haben
on hindernisse hie zwischen vnd sant Martins tag der
schirest kumpt. Vnd sy sullen danne vff den selben
sant Martins tag vnuerzogenlichen reychen geben vnd
antwurten den obgenanten herren dem techant vnd dem
capitel des vorgenanten styfts vnd allen iren nachkumen
furbaz alle jare ewichlichen vff sant Martins tag jerlichen
zwen zentner oleys [?]: da mit sol man danne die vor-
genanten aht lieht brunnen daz jare vz on geuerde.
Ez sullen auch dy herren von sant Johans jerlichen
reichen vnd geben den kyrnchern [?] in dem obgenanten styfte
zum tume alle dy reht zinse vnd gulte in aller wyse vnd
mozze als sy daz von alter her geton haben on hinder-
nisse vnd widerrede on geuerde.
Auch haben wir alle funf einmutlichen gemacht vnd
gescheiden, daz dy obgenant beyde party alle vorge-
schriben dinck stuck bunde vnd artickel stet halten sullen
in aller wyse vnd mozze als vorgeschriben stet. Vnd
welch party des vz gienge, vnd niht hielte yegelichen
artickel besunder als hy vorgeschriben stet, wy ofte oder
wy dicke daz geschehe, ye als dicke vnd als ofte ist dy
selbe bruchig party verallen zû pene vmb zweyntzig
guldin, dy sy geben sullen der party dy da niht gebrochen
haben, vnd vmb zweintzig guldin an vnser frawen ca-
pellen vf dem juden platz, vnd vns obgenanten schideluten
auch vmb zweintzig guldin, von den man in danne nihts
lazzen sol.
Diser vnd aller vorgeschriben dinge zû eym gezug-
nisse vnd worem vrkund so haben wir schidelute obge-
nant vnser yeglicher sin eygen jnsigel gehangen an disen
brief, der geben ist nach vnsers herren Cristes geburte
drutzehen hundert iar da nach in dem sehs vnd ahtzigstem
iar, an sant Bartholomeus abent des heiligen zwelfboten.
[…]d wir der techant vnd daz
[…]el, dy obgenanten, haben globt
[…] globen an disem brief fur
[…]nd alle vnsere nachkumen,
[…]elben obgeschriben ryht-
[…]nge vnd einunge stet veste
[…]nd vnuerbrochen zû halten on
[…] geuerde.
[…]d des zû einem woren vr-
[…] so geben wir den ob-
[…]ten herren zu sant Johans
[…] brief, versigelt mit vnsers
[…]s jnsigel.
Vnd wir der balirer, hus co-
mentur, vnd der conuent, dy ob-
genanten, haben gelobt vnd globen
mit guten trûwen an disem brief
fur vns vnd fur alle vnsere nach-
kumen, dy selben obgeschriben
ryhtunge vnd eynunge stet veste
vnd vnuerbrochen zû haben vnd
zû halten als vorgeschriben stet
on alles geuerde.
Vnd des zû eym gezugnisse
vnd worem vrkunde so haben
wir balyrer, Hans Merklin
hus comentur, obgenant bede,
vnser eygen jnsigel zû des ob-
genanten hus zû Wirtzburg
jnsigel gehangen an disen brief,
[vnd] zu vrkunde geben den ob-
genanten dem techant vnd dem
capitel disen brief.
Der geben ist da man zalt nach vnsers herren Cristes geburte
drutzehen hundert jare da nach in dem sehs vnd ahtzigstem jar, an
dem nehsten fritag vor dem heiligen Cristage.
entries.english:
We, Karl von Hesseburg, dean, and the whole chapter together of the cathedral church at Würzburg, declare openly with this letter, for us and all our successors, that concerning all debts, breaches, claims and disputes which we have had until now on behalf of our church with and against the honourable spiritual people the commander and the convent of the house at Würzburg of St. John's Order of the Holy Hospital at Jerusalem, we have settled and agreed amicably and in good spirit with our good will, through the honourable people whom we have appointed on both sides: on our side and that of our chapter, Lord Arnold von Sparneck and Lord Nyclaus von Malkôzz, canons of our aforesaid church; on the other side Lord Friderich Zuren, custos, and Lord Nyclaus Danyel, cantor in the church of Neumünster; Lord Cunrat von Geurychsheim, dean in the same church of Neumünster, who was given and named as umpire for both sides.

We, Cunrat von Bybern, bailiff in Franconia and commander at Wizzense, Johans Mercklin, commander, Brother Cunrat Kyseling, Hans Megelin, Heinrich Trûhsezz, Brother Han, Brother Rychart, and the convent together of the house at Würzburg of St. John's Order of the Holy Hospital of Jerusalem, declare openly with this letter for us and all our successors that, concerning all debts, breaches, claims and disputes which the honourable lords the dean and the chapter of the cathedral church at Würzburg have brought against us and our house on behalf of their church until now, we have settled and agreed with them amicably and in good spirit with our good will, through the honourable people named below: Lord Arnolt von Sparneck and Lord Nyclaus von Malkôs, canons in the aforesaid church of Würzburg, on their side; Lord Friderich Zûrn, custos, and Lord Nyclaus Danyel, cantor in the church of Neumünster, on our side; Lord Cunrat von Gewrychsheim, dean in the same church of Neumünster, who was given as umpire for both sides.
And the same five have unanimously settled and agreed for us, in every way, as written below word for word:
We, Arnolt von Sparneck, Nyclaus von Malkuzz, canons at Würzburg, Cunrat von Geurichsheim, dean of the church of Neumünster at Würzburg, Nyclaus Danyel and Friderich Zuren, canons in the same church of Neumünster, declare and make publicly known with this letter to all who see it or hear it read: concerning all demands, complaints and claims, wars, disputes and defects which the honourable lords the dean and the chapter of the cathedral church at Würzburg on one side, and the commander and the brothers together in the house at Würzburg of St. John's Order of the Holy Hospital of Jerusalem and also the administrators of the same house on the other side have had against each other, concerning rent, goods, income and debts which the aforesaid lords of the house owe to the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid cathedral church, as written below: the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid cathedral church appointed and assigned for their side us two, Arnold von Sparneck and Nyclausz von Malkôzz aforesaid; and the aforesaid lords of the house at Würzburg appointed and assigned for their side us two, Nyclaus Danyel and Friderich Zûrn aforesaid; and the aforesaid two parties gave and assigned me, Cunrat von Geurychsheim, dean of Neumünster, aforesaid, as umpire in these matters; and we have promised to the aforesaid two parties, giving faith by hand in place of an oath, that whatever we five or the majority decide or arrange between the aforesaid two parties, they shall keep firmly and steadily on both sides on the faith they have given about it and on the penalty written below, without fraud.
First, we five aforesaid have unanimously decided and ruled that the aforesaid lords of St. John shall procure for the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid church, from the von Rosenberg, their heirs or their successors who hold or acquire Boxberg, a good letter and document, and the keeping and statement of the notes on which both parties have agreed, concerning the ten pounds of Heller and four Malter of wheat of annual rent which they have had of old on the house and town of Boxberg with its appurtenances. This shall be done and be completed without delay between now and the Christmas next coming, without fraud. But if the lords of St. John could not procure the aforesaid letter and document from the von Rosenberg in the manner written above, they shall assign and assure to the dean and the church of Würzburg the aforesaid annual rent on the house of St. John at Würzburg and on the court "zum Hofschultheizzen" situated in the city of Würzburg with its appurtenances, so that they shall be secure and certain of the aforesaid annual rent as on their other rent properties, until the house of Biebelried comes back into the hands of the order; then they shall assign and assure the aforesaid annual rent so that they shall have and expect it thereafter from it as from their other rent properties. And this shall be done with the favour, will and consent of our lord of Würzburg. And so that it may be completed and carried out for the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid church in the manner written above, the aforesaid lords of St. John and their successors shall thereafter faithfully work, send and complete it, on the faith they have given about it, without any fraud.
Thereafter we five aforesaid have unanimously decided and ruled that the aforesaid lords of St. John shall annually give and hand over to the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid church and their successors forty pounds of wax in every way and measure as they have given it to them of old. But if the aforesaid lords of St. John could free and release the goods from which they give the same forty pounds of wax, within these three years, of all inheritances, rights, rents and incomes, and could hand them over freely as their own free property and without any hindrance, then they [the chapter] shall take the same goods from the lords of St. John; and they shall then declare them free and released of the forty pounds of wax annual rent, without fraud.
Also we five aforesaid have unanimously decided and ruled that the aforesaid lords of St. John shall light and burn the eight lamps in the cathedral church at Würzburg, of which seven are on St. Kilian's choir and one before Our Lady's altar. They shall do this as they have burnt them of old, without hindrance, between now and the St. Martin's day next coming. And they shall then on the same St. Martin's day without delay hand over and deliver to the aforesaid lords the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid church and all their successors from then on every year for ever on St. Martin's day two hundredweights of oil [?]; with this the aforesaid eight lights shall then be burnt for the year, without fraud.
The lords of St. John shall also annually hand over and give to the church servants [?] in the aforesaid cathedral church all the rightful rents and incomes in every way and measure as they have done of old, without hindrance and objection, without fraud.
Also we all five have unanimously decided and ruled that the aforesaid two parties shall keep all the aforesaid matters, pieces, bonds and articles firmly in every way and measure as written above. And whichever party deviates from this and does not keep each article individually as written here, however often or frequently that happens, as often and as many times the same breaching party shall forfeit a penalty of twenty gulden, which they shall give to the party that did not break it, and twenty gulden to Our Lady's chapel on the Judenplatz, and also twenty gulden to us the aforesaid arbiters, from which they shall be released of nothing.
In testimony and true record of this and of all the aforesaid matters, each of us the aforesaid arbiters has hung his own seal on this letter, which is given after the birth of our lord Christ thirteen hundred years thereafter in the eighty-sixth year, on St. Bartholomew's eve, the holy apostle.
[...] And we, the dean and the chapter, the aforesaid, have promised and promise with this letter, for us and all our successors, to keep the same aforesaid settlement and agreement firmly, steadily and unbroken, without any fraud. [...] And as a true record of this we give to the aforesaid lords of St. John this letter, sealed with our chapter's seal.
And we, the bailiff, the house commander and the convent, the aforesaid, have promised and promise in good faith with this letter, for us and all our successors, to hold and keep the same aforesaid settlement and agreement firmly, steadily and unbroken, as written above, without any fraud. And in testimony and true record of this we, the bailiff and Hans Merklin, house commander, the aforesaid both, have hung our own seal together with the seal of the aforesaid house at Würzburg on this letter, and as a record we give this letter to the aforesaid dean and chapter.
Given when one counted after our lord Christ's birth thirteen hundred years thereafter in the eighty-sixth year, on the next Friday before the holy Christmas day.

facts.subject: The von Rosenberg family
facts.content: were to give the Johanniter, their heirs or their successors who hold or acquire Boxberg a letter confirming the annual rent of ten pounds of Heller and four Malter of wheat due on the house and town of Boxberg to the cathedral chapter.
